messages:
anna: Rolling FYI — ap-south1 firmware rollup happened at 02:12 UTC. We're seeing BMC RTC drift of ~+23s on ~40 nodes. The provisioner marked many as stale; GPU pool throughput dropped ~18% and autoscaler triggered burst capacity. Not seeing secure-boot toggles, but PXE timeouts are up. Runbook?

kevin: Yikes. Do we have nvram/UEFI var diffs or is this strictly BMC RTC?

anna: Strictly BMC RTC in the node agent logs. UEFI vars and signatures look fine. A few nodes returned PXE DHCP timeouts because the tag TTLs were off by ~30s and our MAC->host mapping expired.

mike: Can you paste the bmc-agent log snippet? Also which image was being flashed? We did a micro hotpatch last night.

anna: Paste below (redacted BMC IPs):
```
2026-03-20T02:15:09Z node-apse1-034 bmc-agent[1275]: bmc_time=2026-03-20T02:15:32Z local_time=2026-03-20T02:15:09Z skew=+23.1s
2026-03-20T02:15:15Z node-apse1-034 provisioner[904]: pxeboot: dhcp lease timed out after 8s
2026-03-20T02:15:17Z node-apse1-081 bmc-agent[1275]: bmc_time=2026-03-20T02:15:33Z local_time=2026-03-20T02:15:09Z skew=+24.0s
2026-03-20T02:16:05Z node-apse1-034 autoscaler[2201]: triggered burst -> requesting 4 GPUs
```

tara: Quick mitigation: you can try a cold MC reset on affected BMCs, that usually forces RTC sync with the host. Use `ipmitool mc reset cold` or vendor OEM RTC sync API. Do one node first.

anna: Ran `ipmitool -I lanplus -H $BMC -U admin -P $PASS mc reset cold` on 6 nodes in rack r12, those nodes regained correct RTC and provisioner succeeded for them. Will iterate.

kevin: Good. Longer-term we should: 1) make the provisioner accept a 60s skew window during rollout, 2) add a soft-fail path (queue for re-provision instead of marking offline), and 3) add a metric/alert for BMC RTC variance >10s.

mike: Agreed. Also need to check the firmware bundle we pushed — vendor notes mention an RTC edge-case for 1.2.3 -> 1.2.4 rollups on certain BMC builds. Opening vendor ticket now.

deploy-bot: hotpatch rollout started: bmc-firmware-rtc-fix v1.2.4 -> target=12 nodes in ap-south1 (initiated by anna)
